comment: windowsPE pass and specialize commands that run before the machine script.

rules.title: Bypass the TPM 2.0 check
rules.summary: Setup does not require TPM 2.0. On PCs that have a TPM, the module stays enabled and in use.
rules.effect: Installation proceeds on PCs without a TPM or with TPM 1.2, with no incompatibility message.
rules.risk: Without a TPM, automatic device encryption and BitLocker without a startup password are unavailable. Microsoft does not guarantee updates for unsupported PCs.
rules.versions: LabConfig keys work only in Windows 11 Setup (21H2 and later); Windows 10 ignores them.
rules.rollback: Remove the rule; it does not affect the installed system.

rules.title: Bypass the Secure Boot check
rules.summary: Setup does not require Secure Boot to be enabled.
rules.effect: Installation proceeds on PCs with BIOS/CSM or with Secure Boot turned off.
rules.risk: Without Secure Boot, Credential Guard and some kernel protections do not work; LSA protection in this file is configured without a UEFI lock precisely for such PCs.

rules.title: Bypass the processor check
rules.summary: Setup does not check the processor against the list of supported models.
rules.effect: Installation proceeds on processors older than 8th generation Intel and Ryzen 2000.
rules.risk: In 24H2 the POPCNT and SSE4.2 instruction requirement cannot be bypassed: installation is impossible on very old processors.

rules.title: Bypass the memory check
rules.summary: Setup does not require 4 GB of memory.
rules.effect: Installation proceeds on PCs with less memory; the system will run slowly.

rules.title: Bypass the disk size check
rules.summary: Setup does not require 64 GB of disk space.
rules.effect: Installation proceeds on small disks; free space for updates must be monitored.

rules.title: Allow completing OOBE without internet access and a Microsoft account
rules.summary: BypassNRO key: the out-of-box experience does not require a network connection or a Microsoft account.
rules.effect: A safeguard: accounts are created from the file, but if OOBE behavior changes, the key keeps setup from getting stuck on the network screen. Needed when the account is asked during installation: without it, OOBE may stop at the network screen.
rules.versions: Windows 11 21H2 and later. Microsoft announced the removal of the bypasses in 2025 Insider builds; the key works on released 24H2 and 25H2.
rules.rollback: Delete the value; it does not affect the installed system.

actions.description: Allow OOBE to finish without a Microsoft account or network

rules.title: .NET Framework 3.5 from the installation media
rules.summary: Searches connected drives for the sources\sxs folder and enables .NET Framework 3.5 (including 2.0 and 3.0) without internet access.
rules.effect: Legacy accounting and banking programs and drivers for digital signature keys work right after installation.
rules.risk: The media must stay connected during the first restart; otherwise the component is not installed and a WARN entry is written to the log. It can be added later through Settings when internet access is available.
rules.versions: The sources\sxs folder is present in all official Windows 10 and 11 ISOs; it may be missing from stripped-down images.

script: else { Write-Log 'sources\sxs not found on any drive, .NET 3.5 skipped (can be added later from Windows Update)' 'WARN' }
